explanation.tr:
Hava durumu:
• İsim → sıfat (-y): sun → sunny, rain → rainy, cloud → cloudy, wind → windy, fog → foggy, snow → snowy
• Fiiller: It's raining. It snowed last night. (özne her zaman 'it')
• Güçlü ifadeler: heavy rain (şiddetli yağmur, strong değil!), strong wind, thick fog, a light shower, boiling hot, freezing cold
• Tahmin: It's going to rain (kanıt var), It will probably be sunny tomorrow.
Çevre:
• pollution (kirlilik), climate change, global warming, recycle (geri dönüştürmek), waste (atık), reduce, protect, renewable energy, endangered species
• Fiil + isim: cut down trees, save energy, throw away rubbish, protect the environment
explanation.tk:
Howa:
• At → sypat (-y): sun → sunny, rain → rainy, cloud → cloudy, wind → windy, fog → foggy, snow → snowy
• Işlikler: It's raining. It snowed last night. (eýe hemişe 'it')
• Güýçli aňlatmalar: heavy rain (güýçli ýagyş, strong däl!), strong wind, thick fog, a light shower, boiling hot, freezing cold
• Çaklama: It's going to rain (subutnama bar), It will probably be sunny tomorrow.
Daşky gurşaw:
• pollution (hapalanma), climate change, global warming, recycle (gaýtadan işlemek), waste (galyndy), reduce, protect, renewable energy, endangered species
• Işlik + at: cut down trees, save energy, throw away rubbish, protect the environment
explanation.ru:
Погода:
• Сущ. → прил. (-y): sun → sunny, rain → rainy, cloud → cloudy, wind → windy, fog → foggy, snow → snowy
• Глаголы: It's raining. It snowed last night. (подлежащее всегда 'it')
• Сочетания: heavy rain (сильный дождь, не strong!), strong wind, thick fog, a light shower, boiling hot, freezing cold
• Прогноз: It's going to rain (есть признаки), It will probably be sunny tomorrow.
Экология:
• pollution (загрязнение), climate change, global warming, recycle (перерабатывать), waste (отходы), reduce, protect, renewable energy, endangered species
• Глагол + сущ.: cut down trees, save energy, throw away rubbish, protect the environment

title: Food and Drink: Countable, Uncountable and Containers

explanation.tr:
Yiyeceklerin çoğu sayılamaz: bread, rice, milk, water, sugar, cheese, meat, butter, coffee.
• Sayılamazlarla: some/any/much/a little + ölçü kelimeleri: a loaf of bread, a slice of cheese, a glass of milk, a cup of tea, a bottle of water, a bar of chocolate, a kilo of rice, a can of cola, a packet of biscuits, a piece of cake
• Sayılabilir: apple, egg, banana, sandwich → many / a few / how many
• How much sugar? / How many eggs?
Pişirme fiilleri: boil (haşlamak), fry (kızartmak), bake (fırında pişirmek), roast, grill, chop (doğramak), mix
Tat: sweet, salty, sour (ekşi), bitter (acı), spicy (baharatlı/acılı)
explanation.tk:
Iýmitleriň köpüsi sanalmaýar: bread, rice, milk, water, sugar, cheese, meat, butter, coffee.
• Sanalmaýanlar bilen: some/any/much/a little + ölçeg sözleri: a loaf of bread, a slice of cheese, a glass of milk, a cup of tea, a bottle of water, a bar of chocolate, a kilo of rice, a can of cola, a packet of biscuits, a piece of cake
• Sanalýanlar: apple, egg, banana, sandwich → many / a few / how many
• How much sugar? / How many eggs?
Bişirmek işlikleri: boil (gaýnatmak), fry (gowurmak), bake (peçde bişirmek), roast, grill, chop (dogramak), mix
Tagam: sweet, salty, sour (turşy), bitter (ajy), spicy (ýiti/burçly)
explanation.ru:
Большинство продуктов неисчисляемые: bread, rice, milk, water, sugar, cheese, meat, butter, coffee.
• С неисчисляемыми: some/any/much/a little + слова-меры: a loaf of bread, a slice of cheese, a glass of milk, a cup of tea, a bottle of water, a bar of chocolate, a kilo of rice, a can of cola, a packet of biscuits, a piece of cake
• Исчисляемые: apple, egg, banana, sandwich → many / a few / how many
• How much sugar? / How many eggs?
Глаголы готовки: boil (варить), fry (жарить), bake (печь), roast, grill, chop (резать), mix
Вкус: sweet, salty, sour (кислый), bitter (горький), spicy (острый)

title: Free Time: Go, Play, Do and Verb Patterns

explanation.tr:
Etkinliklerde doğru fiil:
• PLAY + top oyunları ve oyunlar: play football, play tennis, play chess, play computer games (+ enstrüman: play the guitar)
• GO + -ing etkinlikler: go swimming, go shopping, go cycling, go fishing, go skiing
• DO + bireysel sporlar/etkinlikler: do yoga, do karate, do exercise, do gymnastics
Sevme fiilleri + -ing: like, love, enjoy, hate, don't mind + doing: I enjoy reading.
would like + to: I'd like to try climbing.
Sıklık: once a week, twice a month, every weekend; I'm into… / I'm keen on… / I'm interested in + -ing
explanation.tk:
Hereketlerde dogry işlik:
• PLAY + top oýunlary we oýunlar: play football, play tennis, play chess, play computer games (+ saz guraly: play the guitar)
• GO + -ing hereketler: go swimming, go shopping, go cycling, go fishing, go skiing
• DO + şahsy sport/hereketler: do yoga, do karate, do exercise, do gymnastics
Halamak işlikleri + -ing: like, love, enjoy, hate, don't mind + doing: I enjoy reading.
would like + to: I'd like to try climbing.
Ýygylyk: once a week, twice a month, every weekend; I'm into… / I'm keen on… / I'm interested in + -ing
explanation.ru:
Правильный глагол с занятиями:
• PLAY + игры с мячом и игры: play football, play tennis, play chess, play computer games (+ инструмент: play the guitar)
• GO + занятия на -ing: go swimming, go shopping, go cycling, go fishing, go skiing
• DO + индивидуальный спорт/занятия: do yoga, do karate, do exercise, do gymnastics
Глаголы предпочтения + -ing: like, love, enjoy, hate, don't mind + doing: I enjoy reading.
would like + to: I'd like to try climbing.
Частотность: once a week, twice a month, every weekend; I'm into… / I'm keen on… / I'm interested in + -ing

title: Home and House: Rooms, Furniture and Chores

explanation.tr:
Ev türleri: flat (daire), detached house (müstakil ev), terraced house (sıra ev), cottage (kır evi).
Odalar ve eşyalar: living room (sofa, armchair, carpet), kitchen (cooker, fridge, sink, cupboard), bedroom (wardrobe, chest of drawers, pillow, blanket), bathroom (bath, shower, basin, towel).
Edatlar: IN the kitchen, ON the wall/floor/shelf, UNDER the bed, NEXT TO the window, ON the first floor, UPSTAIRS/DOWNSTAIRS.
Ev işleri (do/make): do the washing-up, do the cleaning, do the laundry, make the bed, make dinner; tidy up, vacuum, iron, take out the rubbish.
Sahiplik: rent a flat (kiralamak), move house (taşınmak), landlord (ev sahibi), neighbour.
explanation.tk:
Jaý görnüşleri: flat (kwartira), detached house (aýratyn jaý), terraced house (hatar jaý), cottage (oba jaýy).
Otaglar we zatlar: living room (sofa, armchair, carpet), kitchen (cooker, fridge, sink, cupboard), bedroom (wardrobe, chest of drawers, pillow, blanket), bathroom (bath, shower, basin, towel).
Predloglar: IN the kitchen, ON the wall/floor/shelf, UNDER the bed, NEXT TO the window, ON the first floor, UPSTAIRS/DOWNSTAIRS.
Öý işleri (do/make): do the washing-up, do the cleaning, do the laundry, make the bed, make dinner; tidy up, vacuum, iron, take out the rubbish.
Eýeçilik: rent a flat (kireýine almak), move house (göçmek), landlord (jaý eýesi), neighbour.
explanation.ru:
Типы жилья: flat (квартира), detached house (отдельный дом), terraced house (таунхаус), cottage (загородный домик).
Комнаты и мебель: living room (sofa, armchair, carpet), kitchen (cooker, fridge, sink, cupboard), bedroom (wardrobe, chest of drawers, pillow, blanket), bathroom (bath, shower, basin, towel).
Предлоги: IN the kitchen, ON the wall/floor/shelf, UNDER the bed, NEXT TO the window, ON the first floor, UPSTAIRS/DOWNSTAIRS.
Домашние дела (do/make): do the washing-up, do the cleaning, do the laundry, make the bed, make dinner; tidy up, vacuum, iron, take out the rubbish.
Жильё: rent a flat (снимать), move house (переезжать), landlord (хозяин), neighbour.

explanation.tr:
Atasözleri (proverbs) öğüt verir; deyimler (idioms) kelimelerin toplamından farklı bir anlam taşır.
Sık atasözleri:
• Practice makes perfect. (Pratik mükemmelleştirir.)
• Actions speak louder than words. (Söz değil iş önemli.)
• Better late than never. (Geç olsun güç olmasın.)
• Don't judge a book by its cover. (Görünüşe aldanma.)
• The early bird catches the worm. (Erken kalkan yol alır.)
• When in Rome, do as the Romans do. (Gittiğin yerin âdetine uy.)
Sık deyimler:
• a piece of cake = çok kolay; break the ice = buzları kırmak; under the weather = keyifsiz/hasta; cost an arm and a leg = çok pahalı; hit the books = sıkı çalışmak; once in a blue moon = çok nadiren
explanation.tk:
Nakyllar (proverbs) maslahat berýär; idiomalar sözleriň jeminden tapawutly many aňladýar.
Köp ulanylýan nakyllar:
• Practice makes perfect. (Tejribe kämilleşdirýär.)
• Actions speak louder than words. (Söz däl, iş möhüm.)
• Better late than never. (Hiç wagt bolmandan, giç bolsun.)
• Don't judge a book by its cover. (Daşky görnüşe aldanma.)
• The early bird catches the worm. (Ir turan ozar.)
• When in Rome, do as the Romans do. (Baran ýeriňiň adatyna eýer.)
Köp ulanylýan idiomalar:
• a piece of cake = örän aňsat; break the ice = gürrüňi başlamak; under the weather = keselli; cost an arm and a leg = örän gymmat; hit the books = yhlasly okamak; once in a blue moon = örän seýrek
explanation.ru:
Пословицы (proverbs) дают совет; идиомы имеют значение, не равное сумме слов.
Частые пословицы:
• Practice makes perfect. (Повторение — мать учения.)
• Actions speak louder than words. (Дела говорят громче слов.)
• Better late than never. (Лучше поздно, чем никогда.)
• Don't judge a book by its cover. (Не суди по внешности.)
• The early bird catches the worm. (Кто рано встаёт, тому Бог подаёт.)
• When in Rome, do as the Romans do. (В чужой монастырь со своим уставом не ходят.)
Частые идиомы:
• a piece of cake = проще простого; break the ice = растопить лёд; under the weather = неважно себя чувствовать; cost an arm and a leg = стоить целое состояние; hit the books = засесть за учёбу; once in a blue moon = очень редко
